description: The community made update, restore, modding and jailbreak tool for Innioasis Y1 and Y2. Helping you to keep your player up to date, and allowing you to install novel custom firmwares like Rockbox, JJ Launcher, Inniclassic, Solar, Koensayr, Y2Player and more. Updater includes SP Flash Tool and MTKclient and sets these up automatically.
